name: ramp-duplicate-all
description: Load ramp: stop, rewind, play before the window; inside it, once per 96-beat loop of the heavy Sets (51.4286 s at 112 BPM), every top-level track the Set had is duplicated once (/abl/bench/duplicate-all), so the k-th period plays the Set k times; stop afterwards. profiler/control/ramp-report.py splits the window at the duplicate-all replies and finds the highest load that holds.
